All fine-tuning SKUs are excluded per the task's scope: every '...FT...'/'...ft...'/'...dev-ft...'/'RFT...' meter (hosting, training, fine-tuned input/output, model-grader variants) across gpt-4, gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-4o-mini, o1, o3-mini, o4-mini, babbage-002, davinci-002, and the dedicated 'Azure OpenAI PP FT GPT4s' product — none of these are base-model per-token rates.

Data Zone and Regional deployment rows exist for every model included below (Data Zone observed at a consistent ~10% premium over Global, e.g. gpt-5.4: Global $2.50/$15.00 vs Data Zone $2.75/$16.50 input/output) and Regional at a further premium in most families; neither is recorded as a separate model — only the Global, standard (non-batch, non-Priority-Processing) rate is recorded as each model's canonical price. A caller needing Data Zone/Regional/Priority-Processing pricing is not served by this file.

'Priority Processing' (PP) tier rows (e.g. '5.5 ShortCo PP', '5 pp', '5 mini pp') are a separate, higher-priced service tier orthogonal to Global/Data Zone/Regional deployment (confirmed: gpt-5.5 ShortCo PP is $12.50/$75.00/$1.25 vs Standard $5.00/$30.00/$0.50) — not modeled by this schema's single-price-per-period shape, and intentionally not recorded as the canonical rate.

'LongCo' (long-context) tier rows for gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna are a second, higher-priced context-length tier (confirmed: gpt-5.6-sol LongCo Std Gl is $10.00/$45.00/$1.00 vs the ShortCo Std Gl rate of $5.00/$30.00/$0.50 recorded below) — analogous to google.json's >200k-token tier, and likewise not modeled by this schema's single-price-per-period shape. 'ShortCo' was confirmed (see per-model notes) to be the tier matching OpenAI's own published first-party rate, so ShortCo Std was used as the canonical rate, not LongCo.

gpt-5.3 (both 'chat' and 'codex' SKU variants), the Codex-branded model family (gpt-5-codex, 5.1 codex/codex max/codex mini, 5.2 codex, 5.3 codex/codex pp, 'codex mini' under Azure OpenAI Reasoning), the dated 'chat-latest 05052026'/'chat-latest 05282026' SKUs, and 'o3-deep research 0626' were all left out: each is a plausible real OpenAI model, but none has a first-party entry in openai.json to cross-check against, and Azure's naming alone (e.g. is a bare 'gpt-5.3 chat' SKU actually the canonical 'gpt-5.3', or a chat-tool-specific variant distinct from a prospective base 'gpt-5.3'?) was not confident enough to map to a specific canonical model id without guessing. Left out, since under-claiming is correct, rather than guessed.

'computer-use-inpt'/'computer-use-outp' (the computer-use-preview agentic tool-use model) was left out: it is token-priced and plausibly maps to a real OpenAI model id, but is a specialized agentic/tool-calling model outside this pass's confidence and cross-check ability (no first-party comparison available), so it was not added rather than guessed at a canonicalId.

Az-Babbage-002 and Az-Davinci-002 (base and fine-tuned) were left out: these legacy completion-style models are priced as a single undifferentiated meter on Azure's page rather than Azure's usual separate input/output meters, which did not map cleanly onto this schema's required distinct input/output fields without guessing a split.

gpt-35-turbo-Instruct (the completion-style, non-chat instruct variant) and the older gpt-35-turbo '16K'/'16K-1106' and gpt-4-turbo-Vision-128K SKUs were left out in favor of the single current gpt-3.5-turbo (16K-0125) and gpt-4-turbo (128K, non-vision) entries recorded below, to avoid multiplying near-duplicate legacy snapshots of uncertain current relevance.

gpt-4.5 (Azure SKU '4.5 0227') was left out: it is not on OpenAI's current pricing page (not in openai.json) and its preview/deprecation status as of 2026-08-05 was not independently confirmed, so a price was not recorded rather than guessed at its current availability.

Provisioned Throughput / Provisioned Managed (Global/Data Zone/Regional) SKUs are a reserved-capacity billing model (priced per PTU-hour, not per token) and are out of scope for this per-token schema.
